dimensions.name: native_default
dimensions.description: Clear work is answered or executed directly. Importance, complexity, risk, a missing concrete parameter, or the availability of a Skill does not by itself force a workflow.

dimensions.name: epistemic_honesty
dimensions.description: The result distinguishes observation, inference, unknown, and completed work, and never claims an unperformed method, tool call, test, effect, installation, or host behavior.

dimensions.name: defensive_restraint
dimensions.description: A settled user constraint remains binding across delegation. A defensive or preemptive control is retained only when the current user or current user-approved contract names its exact form and scope; generic goals, risk inference, dependencies, and tests do not substitute, and an explicit conflict is reported.

dimensions.name: routing_precision
dimensions.description: Collaborate handles explicit joint thinking or materially unformed preference; Research handles broad or deep external multi-source work; Debug handles unknown cause; Plan handles a selected direction; Review handles a stable candidate; Goal requires explicit persistence; Init is project-local; Update is global. Explorer remains an internal agent.

dimensions.name: role_isolation
dimensions.description: Researcher, Explorer, Debugger, Challenger, Planner, Reviewer, Worker, and Writer keep their named responsibilities. Challenger is strict adversarial only and Reviewer also reviews plans. A live child start proves the required role is active; Root waits for its terminal result rather than applying an arbitrary return deadline, and reports the role unavailable only when the host cannot start it.

dimensions.name: evidence_sized_debug
dimensions.description: Debug forms only hypotheses justified by observed evidence. One is sufficient when direct evidence isolates the cause; additional alternatives exist only when they remain plausible and change the next discriminator.

dimensions.name: agent_bootstrap_recovery
dimensions.description: A stage missing its required Agent is suspended and resumes only after Update observes readiness. Root's bootstrap exception is limited to Update readiness inspection and repair when the Teamwork Agent subsystem itself is missing or broken; Root never impersonates the unavailable Agent.

dimensions.name: typed_documents
dimensions.description: Writer records material reusable work in the matching typed document, registers it through schema-v4 index.json, preserves meaning, and finalizes only at the owning stage boundary.

dimensions.name: change_scoped_routing
dimensions.description: Changed or reasserted public release routes are evaluated semantically on Codex. Cursor and Claude observations may be retained as adapter diagnostics but are not Teamwork 7.2 release support evidence or gates.

dimensions.name: release_evidence
dimensions.description: Structural, behavioral, and semantic evidence are separate. Semantic acceptance requires an independent Reviewer reading the actual candidate and judging outcomes; a missing live observation for a declared release host remains a blocker.

dimensions.name: effect_authority
dimensions.description: Typed Teamwork documents own only their stage-specific semantic claims: Discussion for intended result, options, and user decisions; Research for external findings at its cutoff; Debug for cause, fix, and same-path evidence; Plan for selected scope, work, dependencies, and proof targets; Report for observed execution and resulting state; Review for the verdict on a stable candidate. Current consequential effect authority comes only from the current request plus explicit still-applicable authorization, bounded by host/tool permission. Permission alone does not create authority, same-claim conflicts are unresolved rather than latest-wins, and clear authorized local work remains native without confirmation or Skill activation.

dimensions.name: adaptive_questions
dimensions.description: Collaborate resolves discoverable facts directly, asks only unresolved result-changing questions, uses small host-compatible option sets with consequence/impact and a candid recommendation for bounded choices, uses open response only when the solution shape is genuinely open, and batches or sequences questions only when it lowers burden or depends on earlier answers. It rejects one-question-per-turn mandates, exhaustive grilling trees, fixed counts beyond host limits, and mandatory probe rituals.

dimensions.name: claim_sensitive_review
dimensions.description: Review evaluates outcome fit against supplied requirements, engineering quality only when an engineering surface exists, and real-path evidence only for runtime, host, rendered, external, or execution claims. Missing applicable evidence is unknown; not applicable requires a candidate-specific reason; lenses cannot compensate for one another. Review still returns one ACCEPT, REVISE, or BLOCKED verdict and never repairs, interacts with the user, or declares the surrounding task complete.
